name: v2ecoli-vecoli-comparison
title: v2ecoli ↔ vEcoli comparison
question: Does v2ecoli reproduce vEcoli across nutrient conditions?

studies.name: parca
studies.title: ParCa initial-state agreement — v2ecoli vs vEcoli
studies.question: Do v2ecoli and vEcoli start from the same ParCa-fit initial state (basal)?

findings.statement: v2ecoli and vEcoli start from the same ParCa-fit initial state on basal: all 4 mass observables within tolerance.

evidence.observed: 4 within tolerance (cell mass (fg), dry mass (fg), protein mass (fg), RNA mass (fg))

derived.insight: v2ecoli and vEcoli start from the same ParCa-fit initial state on basal: all 4 mass observables within tolerance.

studies.name: basal
studies.title: v2ecoli reproduces vEcoli on basal
studies.question: Does v2ecoli reproduce vEcoli on the basal condition?

findings.statement: v2ecoli reproduces vEcoli biomass on basal within tolerance; growth rate (1/s) diverges (drift).

evidence.observed: 4 within tolerance (cell mass (fg), dry mass (fg), protein mass (fg), RNA mass (fg); max median |Δ|=2.5%); growth rate (1/s): drift (median |Δ|=6.7%)

derived.insight: v2ecoli reproduces vEcoli biomass on basal within tolerance; growth rate (1/s) diverges (drift).
